title: Abstract DP168: Chronic Stroke Plasma Triggers Microglial Activation and Cognitive Decline in Young Mice

evidence_spans.quote: Results: Mice infused with chronic stroke plasma exhibited impairments
plasma factors from aged mice
Increased gliosis and senescent-like phenotypes were confirmed
Our ongoing work aims to identify the molecular mediators of these effects through multi-omic profiling.

scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: This empirical mouse study reports a confirmed senescent-like phenotype, so cellular senescence is analyzed. Multi-omic profiling is explicitly future work, not part of the current report; no current multi-omics analysis is described.

causal_design_reviewer.exposure_or_intervention: Retro-orbital infusion of plasma from aged mice 6 months after ischemic stroke
causal_design_reviewer.outcome: Recognition and associative memory impairment; microglial activation and related brain inflammatory/senescent markers in young recipient mice
causal_design_reviewer.estimand_or_contrast: Outcomes in young recipients infused with chronic-stroke plasma versus sham-donor plasma
